sanskrit_verse:
धान्यं दशभ्यः कुम्भेभ्यो हरतो 'भ्यधिकं वधः।
न्यूनं त्वेकादशगुणं दण्डं दाप्यो 'ब्रवीन् मनुः॥
transliteration: dhānyaṃ daśabhyaḥ kumbhebyho harato 'bhyadhikaṃ vadhaḥ | nyūnaṃ tvekādaśaguṇaṃ daṇḍaṃ dāpyo 'bravīn manuḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who takes grain in excess of what is permitted from ten vessels shall face capital consequence; one who takes less shall be liable to an elevenfold restitution, as declared by Manu.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority: The Manava Dharma Shastra is enacted under the sovereign cognition of SPH as ultimate jurisprudential source.
Causation: Excess appropriation disrupts cosmic-economic balance and invokes proportional consequence through natural law.
Capacity-based responsibility: Liability scales with measurable capacity to receive, retain, and restore.
Restoration logic: The violated integrity of resource-sharing must be re-established through quantifiable restitution.
Consciousness alignment: All legal consequences aim at recalibrating individual awareness with dharmic flow.
executable_legal_axioms: IF a subject appropriates resources beyond threshold T(n), THEN invoke completion protocol V1 (capital consequence).
IF a subject appropriates resources below threshold T(n), THEN compute restitution R = 11 × value_of_appropriated_resource.
IF restitution is fulfilled, THEN initiate reintegration protocol I3 under witness of Nyaya-adhikari.
IF subject demonstrates repeated misalignment, THEN assign mandatory consciousness recalibration module C1.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes clear thresholds for economic misconduct. Responsibility is determined not by intent but by quantum of breach. Restoration precedes judgment, ensuring societal equilibrium without punitive degradation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that unauthorized surplus-taking ruptures the flow of abundance. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential depletion and imbalance. Proportional liability aligns with capacity to restore. Punishment is absent—only correction through conscious completion remains.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process Alpha: Subject must return stolen grain plus elevenfold addition to community granary.
Integrity Reintegration Module: Mandatory participation in agricultural service until alignment with dharmic exchange is verified.
Nyaya Witness Protocol: Adjudicator certifies fulfillment before societal reacceptance.
Consciousness Recalibration Assignment: Subject undergoes structured learning on right relation to sustenance and ownership.
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source-Authority. Dharma is restored. Reality is non-punitive. Consciousness is the Supreme Adjudicator.
